projectDescription: A retro arcade-themed personal developer portfolio built with React, Vite, and Framer Motion, featuring CRT effects, pixel fonts, and neon glow aesthetics.
keyFeatures: Retro arcade cabinet aesthetic with CRT scanline overlay
Neon glow color palette: purple, lime, cyan, and magenta
Pixel font (VT323) and monospace (JetBrains Mono) typography system
Framer Motion page transitions with brightness/contrast flicker effect
Animated ArcadeButton component with per-color glow variants
React Router SPA with hash-based routing for static hosting
Skills presented as arcade cabinet coin-op displays with hover tooltips
Projects shown as arcade game cartridges with genre and player count metadata
Writing section styled as vintage instruction manuals
Case studies framed as boss fight replays with HP progress bars
Contact page as a retro high-score guestbook leaderboard
Vite build with static per-route HTML files for SEO-friendly deployment
publicApiSurface: mockData: projects (p), skills (s), articles (a), caseStudies (c), guestbook (g)
CSS custom utilities: text-glow-{color}, box-glow-{color}, scanlines-bg, animate-flicker, animate-scanline
Tailwind theme tokens: arcade-bg, arcade-mid, arcade-text, arcade-purple, arcade-lime, arcade-cyan, arcade-magenta
window.__STATIC_PAGE_ROUTE__ (static routing signal for per-page HTML files)
